properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued September 23 at 3:31AM EDT until September 23 at 6:30AM EDT by NWS Miami FL
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Southern Broward County in southeastern Florida...
Northern Miami-Dade County in southeastern Florida...

* WHEN...Until 630 AM EDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Overflowing poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 330 AM EDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 1 and 2 inches of rain have
fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 3 inches are possible over
the area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Miami, Hollywood, Miami Beach, Surfside, Miami Gardens,
Hallandale, North Miami, North Miami Beach, Aventura, Dania
Beach, Sunny Isles Beach, West Park, Miami Shores, North Bay
Village, El Portal, Golden Glades, Pinewood, Little Haiti and
Ojus.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

NWSheadline: FLOOD ADVISORY IN EFFECT UNTIL 630 AM EDT THIS MORNING

properties.headline: Coastal Flood Statement issued September 23 at 2:17AM EDT until September 23 at 6:00PM EDT by NWS Key West FL
properties.description:
* WHAT...Minor saltwater flooding.

* WHERE...Florida Keys.

* WHEN...Through this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Minor saltwater flooding of low elevation streets
and lots is likely. Some storm drains will overflow, and some
seawalls and docks will be overtopped. Boaters can expect less
clearance under fixed bridges. Motorists should remember that
persistent puddles around the times of high tide are almost
certain to contain a mix of saltwater.
properties.instruction: Do not drive through flooded roadways.

NWSheadline: COASTAL FLOOD STATEMENT REMAINS IN EFFECT THROUGH THIS AFTERNOON
